overview: A company admin is in charge of the company's page and its people. In the app you manage the team and can act in any of the company's roles yourself: hire (see Recruiters and office admins), buy (see Buyers) and sell (see Sellers).
can: See the team, change a member's role or office, and remove a member.
Approve or decline people who asked to join.
Add someone who is on ICR, or invite someone by email.
Post and manage jobs, post requirements, and answer other companies' requirements.
Read and answer the company's inbox.
Switch between your companies and yourself, and create another company.

rules: Adding someone does not make them an admin: admin rights come only through an email invitation the person accepts.
Every member, pending add and pending invitation counts against the seats in your company's plan.
Declining removes the request; the person can ask again.

website: The company's details, documents and verification. The app opens these website pages inside itself, from **My companies** and wherever an action needs the company verified.
Products and services, certifications, offices and locations.
The company's plans and invoices, advertising, reports and integrations.
